analysis.headline: USD/KRW rises to 1,343.2 as KOSPI drops 6.2% to 4,697; NDF climbs to 1,344.2
analysis.summary: USD/KRW rose 0.8 KRW to 1,343.2 in Seoul (ECB 1,345.4) as KOSPI tumbled 6.16% to 4,697.51 on chip-stock selling ahead of the BOK meeting and dividend outflows. Strong US Q3 GDP (4.3%) and core PCE (3.3%) lifted 1M NDF to 1,344.2.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW drops to 1,471.2 as hot US GDP & PCE push euro back toward 1.093
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW fell to 1,471.2 (ECB ref 1,471.19). An upward revision in US Q3 GDP (4.3%) and firmer Oct core PCE (3.3%) cemented December Fed hike bets alongside US tariff worries, pulling EUR/USD down to 1.093–1.094 and dragging the cross.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW eases to 844.4 per 100 JPY with yen hovering near 159.3 below 160
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW dipped to 844.4 per 100 JPY (ECB ref 8.444). USD/JPY traded sideways near 159.2–159.3 as Fed hike bets after strong US data clashed with intervention risk near 160 and equity safe-haven flows, leaving JPY/KRW slightly softer.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW declines to 1,757.1 as tech volatility and firm USD pull pound to 1.306
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW slipped to 1,757.1 (ECB ref 1,757.06). Solid US data and risk-off swings from AI and tech-stock volatility kept the greenback supported, pushing GBP/USD back below 1.310 toward 1.306 as Seoul USD/KRW closed at 1,343.2.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW slips to 201.5 as tariff jitters offset PBOC's strongest 6.7088 fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW edged down to around 201.5 (ECB ref 201.54). Although the PBOC set the USD/CNY midpoint firmer at 6.7088—its strongest since July 2022—US tariff concerns, risk aversion, and USD/KRW rising to 1,343.2 kept the cross subdued.

AUD.headline: AUD drops to 883.9 KRW as risk-off tech selling outweighs hot 4.9% CPI
AUD.brief: AUD fell to 883.9 KRW as Asian tech selling and US tariff worries overshadowed Australia's hot 4.9% CPI, dragging AUD/USD to 0.657.

CAD.headline: CAD climbs to 943.6 KRW on $81 WTI crude and hawkish BoC inflation stance
CAD.brief: CAD rose to 943.6 KRW as WTI crude topped $81 on Middle East tensions and BoC's Macklem flagged inflation risks, pulling USD/CAD to 1.425.

CHF.headline: CHF rises to 1,619.4 KRW on safe-haven demand amid tech & tariff jitters
CHF.brief: Swiss franc climbed to 1,619.4 KRW as tech volatility and US tariff fears pushed EUR/CHF down to 0.908 alongside firmer USD/KRW.

CNY.headline: CNY slips to 201.5 KRW as US tariff caution offsets firm 6.7088 PBOC fix
CNY.brief: Yuan eased to 201.5 KRW as US tariff jitters and risk aversion outweighed PBOC's strongest USD/CNY midpoint since 2022 at 6.7088.

EUR.headline: EUR falls to 1,471.2 KRW as hot US GDP & PCE push euro toward 1.093
EUR.brief: Euro dropped to 1,471.2 KRW as upbeat US GDP (4.3%), core PCE (3.3%), and tariff caution weighed EUR/USD down toward 1.093.

GBP.headline: GBP declines to 1,757.1 KRW as tech swings and firm USD pull pound to 1.306
GBP.brief: Sterling fell to 1,757.1 KRW as strong US data and tech volatility drove GBP/USD back under 1.310 to 1.306 against 1,343.2 KRW.

HKD.headline: HKD edges up to 171.6 KRW tracking USD/KRW rise to 1,343.2 near 7.838 peg
HKD.brief: Hong Kong dollar held near 7.838 inside its USD peg band and edged up to 171.6 KRW alongside Seoul's 0.8 KRW rise in USD/KRW.

JPY.headline: JPY eases to 844.4 KRW per 100 JPY as USD/JPY hovers near 159.3 below 160
JPY.brief: USD/JPY held near 159.3 between strong US data and intervention risk near 160, nudging JPY/KRW slightly lower to 844.4.

KRW.headline: KRW dips to 1,343.2 as KOSPI drops 6.2% to 4,697; NDF climbs to 1,344.2
KRW.brief: Won slipped 0.8 KRW to 1,343.2 as KOSPI sank 6.16% to 4,697.51 ahead of BoK and dividend outflows; 1M NDF rose to 1,344.2.

USD.headline: DXY holds firm at 103.7 on 4.3% US GDP & 3.3% core PCE; Seoul 1,343.2
USD.brief: Despite 10Y yields easing to 4.85%, 4.3% GDP and 3.3% PCE kept Dec Fed hike odds high, holding DXY at 103.7 and Seoul at 1,343.2.
